import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*A**3
            + p[4]*t*A**p[5] + p[6]*t**2
            + p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*t)*A**p[9])
